timeline.title: HFCL profit jumps over fivefold
timeline.line: Revenue rose 143% to ₹2,541.79 cr; consolidated profit was ₹362.91 cr
more: Profit up ~435% from ₹67.86 cr a year ago
Sources differ on profit (₹362.91 cr vs ₹394.22 cr)
